ideas.pitch: A fast-paced 2D puzzle platformer where gravity and level layouts invert based on mathematical symmetry lines.
ideas.title: Symmetry Shift
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the explicit rule in the prompt: incorporating simple creative elements like patterns and symmetry for additional bonus points.

ideas.pitch: An educational 2D visual novel and resource management game focused on water conservation mechanics.
ideas.title: Echoes of the Tides
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to judges looking for a polished narrative and educational value, mirroring previous successful entries in educational gaming.

ideas.pitch: A 2D endless runner controlled entirely by vocal inflections and pitch to jump over obstacles.
ideas.title: Voice Runner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Stands out in a room full of standard keyboard-controlled games by utilizing a unique input method, similar to voice-controlled hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A 2D tower defense game where turret upgrade trees strictly follow the Fibonacci sequence and geometric spirals.
ideas.title: Fibonacci Frenzy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines addictive arcade gameplay with deep mathematical integration to score maximum points on the symmetry and patterns rubric.

ideas.pitch: A 2D grid-based strategy game where players must tile shapes perfectly to build defenses and defeat oncoming enemies.
ideas.title: Tessellation Tactics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Satisfies the technical execution and creativity criteria by turning complex mathematical tessellations into a fun, playable core mechanic.
